title: Omni-Captioner: Data Pipeline, Models, and Benchmark for Omni Detailed Perception
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development of an agentic data pipeline, multimodal perception models (Audio-Captioner and Omni-Captioner), and a novel cloze-style benchmark (Omni-Cloze) for evaluating fine-grained audio-visual descriptions. It does not address religious, faith-based, moral, or ethical topics.
